The '''Demophon Council''' was a council on [[Demophon]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it ignored findings by scientists that their sun [[Demophon (star)|Demophon]] would [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] in a matter of decades.
